integrity: All four finite face sets, acyclic Hasse matchings, and integral Morse differentials can be reconstructed from the embedded standalone files.
scientific_limitations: An exact four-case integral homotopy classification for bidirected cycles of lengths three through six with one bidirected pendant leaf; no infinite periodicity, higher cycle lengths, or equivariant splitting is claimed. The finite certificates and mathematical argument have received same-model review but no independent audit.
title: A one-leaf bidirected-cycle fault response through the four initial residue classes
